title: fix: support GFM protocol autolinks
body:
**Marked version:** master

**Markdown flavor:** GitHub Flavored Markdown

## Description

- Addresses the protocol-autolink subgroup of #4050 (GFM 0.29 examples 633–635).
- Recognizes mailto: and xmpp: extended autolinks using the GFM email grammar.
- Supports one optional XMPP resource segment and stops before a second slash.
- Leaves the bare-email domain fix in #4063 untouched.

AI disclosure: OpenAI Codex assisted with implementation and validation; I reviewed and own the contribution.

## Contributor

- [x] Tests exist to ensure functionality and minimize regression.
- [x] This is existing GFM behavior, so no feature documentation is required.

## Testing

- npm test
- npm run rules
